method: Weigh the individual pizza base before cooking, using the raw weight listed in the ingredients. Preheat the oven to the temperature stated on its packet. Put a baking tray inside to heat. Keep the base ready on a board; follow any packet instruction to pre-bake it, and use its stated baking time for the final oven stage.
Slice the mixed peppers thinly. Heat half of the measured olive oil in a non-stick frying pan over a medium heat and cook the peppers for 5–6 minutes until softened; transfer them to a clean bowl.

Keep the 5% beef mince ready to break into small pieces in the pan. After handling raw 5% beef mince, wash hands and clean the board, knife and work surface before touching the ready-to-eat ingredients.

Add the remaining half of the measured olive oil to the non-stick frying pan. Cook the beef mince over a medium-high heat for about 8–10 minutes, breaking up clumps and stirring until browned. Check the centre with a clean food thermometer: it must stay at 75°C or above for 30 seconds. Without a thermometer, cut the thickest piece open and check that it is steaming inside with no pink meat. Continue cooking until these checks are met; the suggested pan time alone is not a safety check.

Transfer the cooked beef mince to the bowl of peppers. Add the measured tomato passata to the empty frying pan and simmer gently for 3–4 minutes, stirring, until slightly thickened so it will not soak the base.

Put the measured katsu-style sauce into a small saucepan. Warm over a low heat, stirring, for about 2–3 minutes until bubbling and hot throughout; follow a longer cooking time on the sauce label. Keep warm for serving.

Spread all the thickened tomato passata over the individual pizza base, leaving a narrow border. Arrange the cooked peppers and the cooked beef mince evenly on top, then spoon over the warm sauce. Carefully slide onto the hot tray.
Bake for the pizza base packet's stated time, until the dough is cooked through, the base is crisp underneath and the topping is hot throughout. Rest for one minute, cut and serve.

review.notes: Baked individual pizza base with red passata beneath browned beef mince crumbles, cooked mixed red/yellow peppers and katsu-style sauce. No cheese or herbs, correct cooked mince rather than meat strips. Crisp browned dough border and single centred pizza.
